mistake_reason: At step 2, the orchestrator directed FileSurfer to search local files for the answer instead of using WebSurfer to retrieve the web-based LibreTexts 1.E page. This inappropriate tool selection (FM-4.3) led the team to rely on an unrelated local CK-12 veterinary case studies PDF. The wrong source produced the incorrect surname “Louvier,” rather than consulting the correct online section and extracting the accurate “Louvrier.”
